title: metricChanges
responsibility: Formats source-size, complexity and runtime measurement comparisons, producing deltas only for compatible evidence and explicit messages for missing or changed context.

inputs.name: metricChanges.before
inputs.description: The earlier entity profile: source-size and complexity rows, raw values, and runtime workload, target, profile and unit context.

inputs.name: metricChanges.after
inputs.description: The later entity profile whose source-size, complexity, latency and compatible memory samples are matched with the earlier profile by metric key.

outputs.name: metricChanges
outputs.description: Ordered source-size, complexity, latency and memory display rows with before/after text and a signed delta or explicit missing/incompatible-evidence message; changed workload, target or profile context is retained.
